title: 第一章：今天开始营业 · 第5节：旧矿道：第一次主动出发
description: 三人取得第一块修复碎晶，记录异常拖痕后返回。更深处的调查留待准备充分之后。
source: 原创奇幻剧情与四道分段听力题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线固定角色英文配音 · 莉瑟：MiniMax 温暖少女

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The iron gate stands partly open, with loose stones scattered below. Aelia tests the ground with the edge of her shield.
lines.translation: 入口的铁栏半掩着，地面散落碎石。艾莉娅先用盾沿探了探脚下。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Stay behind me and avoid the loose slab on the right. First, make sure the exit remains in sight.
lines.translation: 站在我身后，别踩右侧松动的石板。我们先确认出口一直可见。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The sign reads, 'West passage ventilated; east passage collapsed.' The arrows are faded, but the words are clear.
lines.translation: 木牌写着“西道通风，东道塌陷”。箭头有些褪色，字还看得清。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: The lantern leans west. It gives us a direction, but cannot judge the passage for us.
lines.translation: 提灯偏向西边。可它只告诉我们方向，不能替我们判断那条路。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: There is airflow to the west. We inspect that passage first. Mark every turn, and stay out of the collapsed eastern one.
lines.translation: 西边有风，先看西道。每过一个转角留个标记，塌陷的东道不进。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lu Chuan draws an arrow on the entrance wall, noting the first turn and the position of the exit.
lines.translation: 陆川在入口石壁上画下箭头，记录了第一处转角与出口的位置。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A low shape lunges from beneath an abandoned cart. Aelia raises her shield, and the impact echoes between the stone walls.
lines.translation: 低矮的影子从废矿车下扑出。艾莉娅举盾，金属撞击声在石壁间回荡。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Do not run blindly backward! The left side is clear. Lu Chuan, help me see where it lands.
lines.translation: 别往后乱跑！左侧空着，陆川，帮我照清它的落点。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The card says 'restrain', not 'attack'. I will limit its movement, then you can push it back.
lines.translation: 卡牌上的“牵制”不是攻击。我先限制它移动，你再把它挡开。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: I will hold the light to the left, away from your eyes. It is about to leap again!
lines.translation: 灯放左边，不照你的眼睛。它又要扑了！

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The word pact binds the creature's front claws. Aelia drives it behind the cart with her shield, and the three regain their footing.
lines.translation: 言契束住怪物的前爪，艾莉娅用盾将它逼回废矿车后。三人重新站稳。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: That is enough. Do not chase it. It has withdrawn; we will inspect the stone ledge before the junction.
lines.translation: 够了，不追。它退开了，我们继续看岔路前的石台。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: These drag marks all lead toward the ledge. They do not look random. The creatures may be searching for the same thing.
lines.translation: 这里的拖痕都朝着石台，不像随便路过。它们可能在找同一个东西。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: The butterfly has stopped over a crack in the rock. There is a crystal inside, the same color as the one on your counter.
lines.translation: 光蝶停在石缝上了。缝里有一块晶体，颜色和你们吧台上的一样。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: Do not reach in yet. Something is moving beneath the ledge. I will hold it back.
lines.translation: 先别伸手。石台底下还有动静，我来挡住。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The marking says, 'Release the catch before lifting the cover.' Pulling it directly will tighten the gap.
lines.translation: 标记旁边写着“先松扣，再抬盖”。硬拉会把石缝压紧。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: I found the catch. Following the instructions has freed the crystal.
lines.translation: 我找到了扣环。按说明来，晶体没有卡住了。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lyse lifts out the fragment and wraps it in cloth. The lantern's light gathers into a circle around her palm.
lines.translation: 莉瑟取出碎晶，用布包好。提灯的光缩成一圈，绕在她掌心。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The guardian beneath the ledge strikes the shield. Aelia steadies herself a step back as Lu Chuan opens the restraint card again.
lines.translation: 石台下的守卫兽撞向盾面。艾莉娅退半步站稳，陆川再次展开牵制卡。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: We have the fragment. Follow the marks out! I will block once more. We do not need to fight to the end here.
lines.translation: 碎片拿到了，沿标记退！我挡最后一下，不需要在这里打到底。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Two arrows on our return route; the exit is left after the turn. Lyse goes first, then me, with Aelia covering the rear.
lines.translation: 原路两处箭头，出口在转角左边。莉瑟先走，我跟着，艾莉娅断后。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: There is another echo deeper inside... but we agreed to stop at the first junction. We leave it today.
lines.translation: 深处还有回声……但我们答应过只看第一处岔路。今天不追了。

lines.speaker: 艾莉娅
lines.text: We will report the marks to the guards. Next time, we need a map and better preparation.
lines.translation: 回去把拖痕的位置交给守卫。下次来，得有地图和更多准备。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: As they step past the iron gate, the night breeze clears the stone dust. Lu Chuan looks back to make sure everyone is there.
lines.translation: 三人走出铁栏时，夜风吹散了石尘。陆川回头确认，每个人都在。

questions.prompt: Why do they inspect the western passage first?
options: It has airflow, while the eastern passage is marked as collapsed.
The eastern passage leads straight to the tavern.
They want to hide the exit.
The lantern guarantees that no danger exists.
questions.explanation: 路牌提示西道通风、东道塌陷，提灯不能代替安全判断。

questions.prompt: How does Lu Chuan help during the first encounter?
options: He chases the creature into the depths.
He restricts the creature's movement so Aelia can push it back.
questions.explanation: 牵制卡限制移动，艾莉娅以盾逼退怪物；没有追击。

questions.prompt: What must they do before lifting the cover?
questions.explanation: 说明明确要求先松扣，再抬盖，硬拉反而压紧石缝。

questions.prompt: Why do they return instead of following the deeper echo?
options: The inn no longer needs repairs.
They have the fragment and agreed to limit this investigation.
The guards ordered them to abandon the town.
questions.explanation: 已取得碎晶，遵守只调查入口与第一岔路的约定，准备充分后再探索深处。

ending: 三人取得第一块修复碎晶，记录异常拖痕后返回。更深处的调查留待准备充分之后。
